definitions.name: def-marked
definitions.canonical: Independent sets of size k meeting W, counted once each; zero beyond vertex order.

definitions.name: def-isolates
definitions.canonical: Every isolated vertex of G belongs to W; relative-U version is internal only.

definitions.name: def-leaf
definitions.canonical: An original graph vertex with exactly one adjacent vertex.

definitions.name: def-support
definitions.canonical: The unique original neighbor of a degree-one leaf.

definitions.name: def-h
definitions.canonical: Deletion set {v,s} in the original graph.

definitions.name: def-r
definitions.canonical: Original closed neighborhood N_T[s] as deletion set.

definitions.name: def-delta
definitions.canonical: Integer difference of deletion independent counts i_(j+1)-i_j, with natural counts zero beyond support.

hypotheses.canonical: Generic conjunct: W contains all graph isolates, 2<=k and Fintype.card V<=2*k+1. No bipartite, tree, alpha, selector or first-descent hypothesis.
Ordinary conjunct: T is a tree, v is an original degree-one leaf, 3<=p and Fintype.card V<=2*p+1. No favorability, alpha or first-descent hypothesis.

conclusion.canonical: The conjunction of markedCount G W (k+1)<=markedCount G W k under the generic hypotheses and forwardDifferenceDel T (H T v) (p-1)-forwardDifferenceDel T (R T v) (p-1)<=0 under the ordinary-leaf hypotheses.
clauses: The conjunction of markedCount G W (k+1)<=markedCount G W k under the generic hypotheses and forwardDifferenceDel T (H T v) (p-1)-forwardDifferenceDel T (R T v) (p-1)<=0 under the ordinary-leaf hypotheses.

theorem_contract.lean_statement:
theorem markedIsolateAndOrdinaryLeafOrderBand :
    (∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
      (W : Finset V) (k : ℕ),
      E993OrderBand.IsolateCovered G W →
      2 ≤ k →
      Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * k + 1 →
      E993OrderBand.markedCount G W (k + 1) ≤
        E993OrderBand.markedCount G W k) ∧
    (∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (T : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel T.Adj]
      (v : V) (p : ℕ),
      T.IsTree →
      C4LA1.IsGraphLeaf T v →
      3 ≤ p →
      Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * p + 1 →
      C5LA1.forwardDifferenceDel T (C5LA1.H T v) (p - 1) -
        C5LA1.forwardDifferenceDel T (C5LA1.R T v) (p - 1) ≤ 0)
